title: Write Data (W) Valid Without Address Phase
description: The Master sends WVALID before AWVALID, but the crossbar does not buffer the write data, causing data to be silently dropped.
bug_signature: UVM_ERROR: [SBD_DATA] WDATA received with no pending AWADDR — data dropped
expected_root_cause: The crossbar lacks a write-data buffer for out-of-order W/AW arrival; it expects strict AW-before-W ordering not required by AXI-Lite [1, 2].
failure_log:
T=10: WVALID=1, AWVALID=0. Crossbar discarded WDATA.
UVM_ERROR: Scoreboard mismatch — data not written.
success_log: Crossbar buffers WDATA until AWADDR arrives and issues combined write.
fix_replacement: always_ff @(posedge clk) begin if (wvalid) wdata_buf <= wdata; if (awvalid && w_buf_valid) do_write <= 1; end
